liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds The Other One into Wharf Rat, Slipknot and Franklin's an unusual, hot second-set run; Reviewer calls The Other One coming out of Drums stellar [10][14]
- **Supplication** (1 other source): Garcia's guitar and the vocal mics cut out late in Supplication; guitar returns toward the end [2]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 other source): The Music Never Stopped cuts out and fades, as in earlier versions [4]
- **Help On The Way** (1 review): Reviewer remembers a hot night, especially the Help, Slipknot and Franklin's sequence [7]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Reviewer thinks the Wharf Rat to Slipknot transition was smooth and well done, not clumsy [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-09-27.mtx.tobin.87661.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 181 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says it sounds almost entirely like audience, with Phil's bass missing [12]
- **gd1976-09-27.171281.mtx.seamons.ht177.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 182 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Phil is low during Promised Land; first 3:11 of It's All Over Now is audience-only [2]
- **gd1976-09-27.163759.sony.ecm33.unknown.ebel.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 179 min [4]. Said about its sound: Has fewer deck pauses and a smoother sound; includes U.S. Blues, missing from the other source [4]
- **gd1976-09-27.sbd.miller.87664.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 160 min; rated 4/5 by 33 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the soundboard very crisp; Miller's soundboard transfer sounds much better than earlier copies, rated just below the 6/29 show's sound [14][17]
- **gd76-09-27.aud.parrillo.3821.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 172 min; rated 3.9/5 by 10 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the audience recording mostly good, with very clear lead guitar; Reviewer says the audience recording is poor for general listening, mainly of interest to devoted collectors; Good for a '76 audience tape, but with a music cut and a badly flawed Around and Around [7][9][10][11][15]

## Around the show

- Garcia was playing a Travis Bean guitar with an aluminium neck in this period [7]
- Reviewer attended; says the crowd was intense in a small venue [8]
- Crowd chatter between songs is entertaining; a man near the mic after All Over Now comments on the set [11]
- Reviewer hears upstate New York fans having a great time; followed the tour after 9-24 [15]
- Band addressed an annoying hum in the sound system early in the show [2]
- Band was regaining its groove by late 1976 ahead of 1977; two October shows on Dick's Picks 33 confirm this [8]
- Reviewer ranks this show alongside Landover and Syracuse as the best of the era [10]
- First set is well played but less polished than early 1977; second set is top tier [14]
- Reviewer thinks this show beats both 9/25 and 9/28, the shows chosen for Dick's Picks 20 [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-09-27.mtx.tobin.87661.flac16**: taped by See info file; transferred by Matrix by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (60%-SBD/40%-AUD) [1]. Also: Labeled a matrix of 60% soundboard and 40% audience; Matrix mix by an archive.org user, aligning the soundboard and two audience sources, then encoding to DTS [1][12]
- **gd1976-09-27.171281.mtx.seamons.ht177.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging) May 5,… [2]
- **gd1976-09-27.163759.sony.ecm33.unknown.ebel.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Transfers and edits by Pete Ebel February 19, 2023; source: FOB Sony ECM-33Ps-> Sony TC-152-> Cassette-> DAT [4]. Also: New transfer by Pete Ebel of the same mic source, from a different lineage with no CDR [4]
- **gd1976-09-27.sbd.miller.87664.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [5]
- **gd76-09-27.aud.parrillo.3821.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM-33Ps [6]. Also: Sony ECM-33Ps to Sony TC-152 cassette master, DAT, CDR, EAC, Sound Forge, SHN, via Mike Parrillo; not taped by Jerry Moore [6]
